title: Increase secret management's level of protection
body:

Add layer of security, encrypt the secret values for the app deployed in the cloud.

## Update

Closing this since its possible to set `secrets` programmatically via `st.App`: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14861 see: https://docs.streamlit.io/develop/api-reference/server/st.app

This allows setting secrets from more secure key vaults or provides you with custom ways to encrypt/decrypt your secrets before providing it to your Streamlit app.
